---
title: "check-split-solutions.yml"
---

Diff-scoped check that fails a pull request which touches a split exercise
whose solution was not split with it.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-28) is that a solution is split
the way its exercise is: one `#sol-` per `#exr-`,
each with the slug of its exercise.
It complements [check-multipart-exercises](check-multipart-exercises.qmd),
which reads only the exercise side.
This implements
[gha#1290](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1290).

A *group* is the set of `#exr-` divs that share a slug
once a trailing `-partK` is removed.
A group with two or more exercises is *split*.
The ids may sit in different subfiles, so the check indexes
every file the globs match.
In a split group it reports:

- an exercise with no `#sol-` of the same slug;
- a `#sol-` with no exercise of that slug;
- a solution that labels parts:
  two lettered list items in one marker style (`(a)`/`(b)`, `a.`/`b.`),
  or a line opening "Part 2:".
  A numbered list is not flagged, because it can be the answer itself;
- a solution that holds a figure chunk (`#| label: fig-...` or `#| fig-cap`)
  when its own exercise does not ask for a plot
  but a sibling exercise does.
  This is the case of `#sol-lab-boston-simple`,
  whose figure answered the plot exercises two parts later.

Code, display math and HTML comments are not read for part labels.
A solution that holds `<!-- split-solutions-ok: reason -->` is exempt.

A group is reported when the pull request adds a line inside any of its divs.
With no base to diff against, the check skips
instead of scanning the whole tree.
It fails by default; `fail: false` gives warning annotations only.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive) |
| `paths-ignore` | none | Comma or newline separated globs to skip |
| `fail` | `true` | Fail on a finding; `false` warns |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Report every split group, to measure a corpus |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version |

## Usage

Copy `examples/check-split-solutions.yml` to
`.github/workflows/check-split-solutions.yml`.
